description: This test ensures that users can log in using their GitHub account via OAuth integration.
steps: Locate the GitHub OAuth login button using the stable selector.
Click on the GitHub OAuth login button.
Ensure the browser is redirected to the GitHub OAuth login page.
Enter valid GitHub account credentials and submit.
Verify that the user is redirected back to the application dashboard.
Check that the user's session is authenticated and a valid token is received.
Verify the presence of user-specific data on the dashboard.
expected_results: The user is redirected to the GitHub OAuth login page.
The user is redirected back to the application dashboard after successful authentication.
The user's session is authenticated and a valid token is available.
User-specific data is displayed on the dashboard.
edge_cases: Canceling the GitHub login process midway.
Network issues during the OAuth redirection.
Token expiration before redirection to the app.
data_requirements: OAuth client ID and secret for GitHub integration.
Redirect URI configured in GitHub OAuth settings.
Session storage or cookies to store authentication tokens.
User profile data for verification on the dashboard.
dependencies: GitHub OAuth service must be active and configured correctly.
The application must be registered with GitHub APIs.
The dashboard page must be accessible after login.
performance_metrics: Time taken to load the GitHub OAuth login page.
Time taken to redirect back to the application.
Response time of the user profile API.
accessibility_requirements: Ensure the GitHub login button is keyboard navigable.
Verify proper ARIA roles for the login button.
Check for color contrast compliance on the login button.
